functions.apply_invoice_quotation_deposit_trigger:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_invoice_quotation_deposit_trigger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.quotation_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status<>'CANCELLED' THEN
    PERFORM public.apply_quotation_payments_to_invoice(NEW.quotation_id,NEW.id);
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.guard_night_order_schedule:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_night_order_schedule()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.date IS NULL OR NEW.time IS NULL OR NEW.time_end IS NULL
     OR NEW.status NOT IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','DISPATCHED','ON_SITE','IN_PROGRESS','WORKING')
     OR NOT (NEW.time >= '18:00' OR NEW.time < '09:00') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF NEW.time=NEW.time_end
     OR (NEW.time >= '18:00' AND NEW.time_end < NEW.time AND NEW.time_end > '06:00')
     OR upper(public.slot_tsrange(NEW.date,NEW.time::text,NEW.time_end::text))
       - lower(public.slot_tsrange(NEW.date,NEW.time::text,NEW.time_end::text)) > interval '12 hours'
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Jam malam tidak valid; selesai maksimal 06:00 esok hari'; END IF;
  IF NEW.time >= '18:00' AND NEW.team_slot IS NOT NULL AND NEW.team_slot NOT LIKE 'Malam %' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pekerjaan malam harus memakai slot Malam';
    ELSIF NEW.date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.date OR NEW.time IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.time
       OR NEW.time_end IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.time_end OR NEW.team_slot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.team_slot THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pekerjaan malam harus memakai slot Malam';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('aclean:schedule-plan'));
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o
    WHERE o.id<>NEW.id AND o.date BETWEEN NEW.date-1 AND NEW.date+1
      AND o.status IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','DISPATCHED','ON_SITE','IN_PROGRESS','WORKING')
      AND o.time IS NOT NULL AND o.time_end IS NOT NULL AND o.time<>o.time_end
      AND public.slot_tsrange(NEW.date,NEW.time::text,NEW.time_end::text)
          && public.slot_tsrange(o.date,o.time::text,o.time_end::text)
      AND ((NEW.team_slot IS NOT NULL AND o.team_slot=NEW.team_slot)
        OR ARRAY[NEW.teknisi,NEW.teknisi2,NEW.teknisi3,NEW.helper,NEW.helper2,NEW.helper3]
           && ARRAY[o.teknisi,o.teknisi2,o.teknisi3,o.helper,o.helper2,o.helper3])
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Slot tim atau anggota bertabrakan dengan pekerjaan lain'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.sync_inventory_from_units:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_inventory_from_units()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  kode text;
  total numeric;
BEGIN
  kode := COALESCE(NEW.inventory_code, OLD.inventory_code);
  IF kode IS NULL THEN RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) INTO total
    FROM inventory_units
    WHERE inventory_code = kode AND COALESCE(archived, false) = false;
  UPDATE inventory
     SET stock = total,
         status = CASE
                    WHEN total <= 0         THEN 'OUT'
                    WHEN total <= min_alert THEN 'CRITICAL'
                    WHEN total <= reorder   THEN 'WARNING'
                    ELSE 'OK'
                  END,
         updated_at = NOW()
   WHERE code = kode;
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

functions.sync_order_paid_on_invoice:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_order_paid_on_invoice()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.job_id IS NOT NULL AND upper(coalesce(NEW.status, '')) = 'PAID' THEN
    UPDATE orders
    SET status = 'PAID'
    WHERE id = NEW.job_id AND upper(coalesce(status, '')) <> 'PAID';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.resolve_order_assigned_members:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_order_assigned_members(p_order orders)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  WITH names AS (
    SELECT btrim(person) AS name, position
    FROM unnest(ARRAY[
      (p_order).teknisi,(p_order).teknisi2,(p_order).teknisi3,
      (p_order).helper,(p_order).helper2,(p_order).helper3
    ]) WITH ORDINALITY AS member(person,position)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT btrim(person), position+6
    FROM public.daily_team_slots d,
         LATERAL unnest(ARRAY[
           d.member1,d.member2,d.member3,d.member4,
           d.member5,d.member6,d.member7,d.member8
         ]) WITH ORDINALITY AS member(person,position)
    WHERE d.date=(p_order).date AND d.slot=(p_order).team_slot
      AND (p_order).date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date - 30
  )
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(name ORDER BY first_position),ARRAY[]::text[])
  FROM (
    SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY position))[1] AS name,min(position) AS first_position
    FROM names WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name<>'' GROUP BY lower(name)
  ) distinct_names;
$function$
functions.slot_tsrange:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.slot_tsrange(d date, t_start text, t_end text)
 RETURNS tsrange
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT tsrange(
    d + t_start::time,
    d + t_end::time + CASE WHEN t_end::time < t_start::time
                           THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0 hour' END
  );
$function$
